title: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs: Hop count calculation wrong for expanding ring hop_limit > 4
description: Line 564: `INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT.saturating_sub(rreq.hop_limit)` assumes all RREQs start with hop_limit=4, but EXPANDING_RING uses [4, 8, 15]. When hop_limit starts at 8 or 15, saturating_sub returns 0 instead of the correct hop count (e.g., hop_limit=7 after 1 hop from 8 yields 4-7=0, should be 1). This corrupts reverse_route.hop_count for 2 of 3 expanding ring stages, affecting routing metric decisions during normal expanding ring operations.
close_reason: Fixed: Added infer_original_hop_limit() to determine the correct original hop limit from current hop_limit by finding the smallest EXPANDING_RING value >= current value. Updated process_rreq() to use this instead of hardcoded INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT. Added 4 tests covering ring stages 2 and 3.
